doc: The sources of the receiving side (panels/extra/output_target.html; D-unified-dock): where the lines the frame's receiving side shows come from. In the order shown; letter is what selects one (with a number after it when the skin has more than one of it). The ids are those of input_target/ where they are the same thing, so that while the keyboard is in the input form the receiving side follows where it sends. Each id has output_target/<id>.json. test/output-target-dir.test.js checks this list against the directory.
